freshretail.sample: 3000 smallest SHA256 of freshretail:{store_id}:{product_id}; IDs only

vn1.sample: all 15053 series in official row order

development: first two origins; choose best single model by pooled aggregate WAPE; final origin not used for selection
training_origins: freshretail: from 28 with step7, plus latest valid origin; vn1: latest 8 origins separated by 13 weeks, all at least 52
information: calendar known; fresh planned discount/activity/holiday conditional on plan availability; weather and stock history summaries at origin only; VN1 price history only, never test prices
metrics: mean per-series WAPE excluding zero-denominator with count
non_goals: no hyperparameter search on final test
no claim of best achievable LightGBM accuracy
